text: . Bangladesh Police have recovered 20 crude bombs, 41 torch sticks and several sheets of polystyrene during an operation near Mirpur in Dhaka. Acting on a tip-off, a team from Mirpur Model Police Station conducted the operation. According to Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP), 15 crude bombs were found in three paper bags, while five others were lying on the road. Police also seized the torch sticks and kerosene bottles. The DMP’s bomb disposal unit later arrived at the scene and safely defused the explosives.

. Global crude oil prices rose today, recovering from steep losses suffered in the previous session. Brent crude was trading 2.2 per cent up at 96 US dollars and 71 cents per barrel. West Texas Intermediate crude was trading one and a half per cent higher at 89 US dollars and 42 cents per barrel at the time of writing this report.

. Ayodhya in Uttar Pradesh is set to celebrate the 10th edition of Deepotsav today, with more than 30 lakh earthen lamps set to illuminate the holy city on the eve of Diwali. Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan will attend the celebrations. During his visit, he will offer prayers at the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple, participate in the symbolic coronation ceremony of Prabhu Shri Ram and felicitate revered saints.This year’s celebrations will have a strong international presence, with around 2,500 artists from India and abroad set to showcase Ramlila and cultural performances across 12 stages. Performers from countries including South Africa, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Laos and Thailand will bring diverse cultural interpretations of the Ramayana to the celebrations.A special exhibition at Ram Katha Park will also showcase Ayodhya’s 500-year historical journey, the Ram Temple movement and the city’s transformation. The exhibition will feature historical documents, cultural presentations and displays highlighting the development of the Ram Temple complex and the city’s infrastructure.The initiative aims to position Deepotsav as an international cultural event and strengthen Ayodhya’s identity as a global centre of Ramayana heritage.

. Prime Minister Narendra Modi said that the government is building a modern sports ecosystem through school and grassroots programmes, Khelo India Centres and Olympic-standard training under the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS).Felicitating India’s Asian Para Games 2026 contingent for its record haul of 114 medals, Prime Minister urged the athletes to build on their success as they prepare for the Los Angeles 2028 Games.Prime Minister also recalled his appeal from the Red Fort encouraging young people to participate in a nationwide talent hunt with the Olympics in focus. He said Para-sports also receive equal priority under these initiatives.Interacting with the contingent at the Indira Gandhi Sports Complex in New Delhi, PM Modi said the performance reflected India’s emergence as a major global sporting power. He congratulated the athletes, their families, coaches and trainers, saying the players had won both medals and the hearts of millions.India secured 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze medals, alongside five world records and nine Asian records. Comparing the achievement with the country’s tally of 14 medals, including one gold, in 2010, PM Modi credited the athletes’ perseverance and dedication.The Prime Minister noted that 34 of the contingent’s 56 female athletes won medals, while Indian competitors swept all three podium positions in four events. The team also won nine gold medals on the final day.Highlighting individual performances, PM Modi said Mona Agarwal set a world record in para shooting, while Haney improved his own world record. He also praised Himanshu, Ravi and Jehan for overcoming physical challenges through their performances.Recalling the sacrifices behind sporting success, PM Modi spoke about Rinku, who lost his mother two months before the Games and held up her photograph after winning gold. “That moment made all of us emotional,” he said.The Prime Minister also highlighted the achievements of younger athletes, noting that 36 of the 61 debutants won medals and Sandeep set a world record on his debut.Describing sports as a means of personality development and nation-building, PM Modi said it teaches discipline, teamwork and the ability to recover from setbacks. He added that the expansion of sports infrastructure, equipment manufacturing and broadcasting was creating employment opportunities beyond the playing field.

. India and the European Union have successfully concluded negotiations on New Delhi’s association with Horizon Europe, the bloc’s 93.5-billion-euro flagship research and innovation funding programme. Under the arrangement, Indian researchers, businesses and research organisations will be eligible to receive direct funding from Horizon Europe and lead international collaborative research projects under its second pillar, which focuses on global challenges and European industrial competitiveness. Once signed and ratified by both sides, the agreement is expected to come into effect in January next year.The programme covers key areas such as healthcare, Artificial Intelligence, digital technology, space, climate, energy and industrial development. The European Commission said the agreement marks a significant milestone in India-EU relations and will strengthen scientific cooperation, create new research opportunities and deepen their strategic partnership.Welcoming the development, EU Commissioner for Startups, Research and Innovation Ekaterina Zaharieva said the agreement would open up new opportunities for businesses, researchers and innovators on both sides to work together in developing future technologies.Horizon Europe currently includes 23 associated non-EU countries, ranging from the United Kingdom, Canada and Japan to South Korea and Switzerland. The association will enable Indian institutions to receive grants directly from the European Commission and allow Indian scientists to lead and coordinate major international research projects in the covered areas, on terms similar to those available to organisations in EU member states.The agreement is expected to give fresh impetus to India-EU scientific and technological cooperation and strengthen collaboration in emerging technologies and innovation.

. The Election Commission today directed Chief Electoral Officers of Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Telangana and Nagaland to provide one more opportunity to voters who were left out during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR).In a statement, the Commission said that voters who were issued enumeration forms but whose names could not be included in the draft electoral roll on account of being marked as Absent, Shifted, Dead and Duplicate will be provided one more opportunity to get their names included in the final electoral roll.The Commission has directed Chief Electoral Officers of Delhi, Maharashtra, Haryana, Andhra Pradesh, Jharkhand, Telangana and Nagaland to display the lists of such electors afresh and facilitate the submission of their Enumeration Forms. The booth-level officers have also been asked to contact the electors and assist them with the process, including online submission through the ECINET platform. Special provisions have also been made for electors who have shifted residence within the state and homeless persons.The Commission has also asked to establish a monitoring mechanism to ensure that no eligible elector is deprived of the opportunity in the Final Electoral Roll while preventing duplicate enrolments.

. The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has announced setting up a Technical Consultative Committee for Financial Markets which will focus on critical policy and operational matters across money markets and government securities.The eight member Committee will be chaired by the Deputy Governor in charge of the Financial Markets Regulation Department, Mr Rohit Jain. The committee will study issues relating to trading, clearing, settlement, reporting and other market infrastructure, including the associated regulatory and operational frameworks. It will also examine the various issues related to the functioning, efficiency, liquidity and resilience of the money, government securities, foreign exchange and related derivative markets.While suggesting measures to deepen and broaden these markets, the committee has also been tasked to identify domestic and international developments, financial innovations, and emerging risks that may affect Indian financial markets.

. Union Health and Family Welfare Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda has called upon people to raise awareness about cancer prevention, recognise early warning signs, and promote timely screening and treatment on the occasion of National Cancer Awareness Day.In a social media post, Mr Nadda underlined that awareness and access to screening remain vital in the fight against cancer. He urged people to undergo screening for common cancers, including oral, breast and cervical cancers, as recommended.He further advised citizens to avoid tobacco and alcohol, exercise regularly, maintain a healthy diet, and seek medical advice in case of unusual or persistent symptoms.The Minister also encouraged everyone to visit their nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir or health facility for information on cancer screening.

. Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment Dr Virendra Kumar today inaugurated the Shilp Samagam Mela 2026 at Dilli Haat, INA in New Delhi this evening. The Mela will provide a dedicated marketing platform to artisans and beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Safai Karamcharis and persons with disabilities to showcase and market their products to a wider audience. Speaking on the occassion, Dr Kumar said the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment has been organising Shilp Samagam Melas since 2022 and more than 1,000 artisans from Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes and Safai Karamcharis have benefited from opportunities to exhibit and market their products.  The Minister said that with approximately 150 stalls for participating male and female artisans to showcase their handicraft and handloom products under Bharat TULIP and Purple Fest, the initiative brings traditional artisans, creative talent and persons with disabilities together on a common platform to encourage wider market access and equal opportunities for participation.  The Mela will remain open to visitors until 15th of this month.

. The Ministry of Railways has stepped up preparations to manage the heavy passenger rush during the Diwali and Chhath festivals. As part of its crowd-management measures, the Railways is operating 18,000 special trains, deploying additional Railway Protection Force personnel and installing Artificial Intelligence-enabled cameras at major railway stations.Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw stated this while inspecting the passenger holding areas at New Delhi Railway Station last evening. Mr Vaishnaw said that New Delhi Railway Station handles over five lakh passengers on an average day, while the daily footfall rises to around eight lakh during peak periods.Mr Vaishnaw further said that more than 700 Artificial Intelligence-enabled cameras have been installed at New Delhi Railway Station to monitor passenger movement and ensure effective crowd management. He added that separate holding areas have been set up this year for reserved and unreserved passengers to ensure their convenience and prevent overcrowding at the station.The Minister also said that similar holding areas have been established at several major railway stations across the country that witness heavy passenger traffic during the festive season.

. Indian Railways has geared up to manage the ongoing festive season rush of Diwali and Chhath Puja, with extensive crowd management preparations underway at several railway stations. Ministry of Railways said that Indian Railways is developing dedicated passenger holding areas, known as Yatri Suvidha Kendras, at major railway stations across the country. This is being done to streamline passenger movement and ease congestion during periods of heavy footfall, including the festive season. The Yatri Suvidha Kendras, or Passenger Holding Areas, are being developed to provide dedicated space for unticketed and waiting passengers. Our correspondent reports that the facilities have been designed to ensure orderly passenger movement and provide a comfortable waiting environment.The holding areas have been designed to accommodate passengers before they proceed to the platform area. Talking to Akashvani News, Northern Railway CPRO  said that at New Delhi Railway station, a holding area is available for both reserved and unreserved classes. He said additional RPF personnel have also been deployed at Railway stations to facilitate passengers.At Anand Vihar Terminal, the Yatri Suvidha Kendra has 14 ticket counters, 16 CCTV cameras, four electronic display boards and seating for 20 passengers. The facility also has separate toilet facilities for male and female passengers, a Divyangjan toilet, an RO plant, 11 HVLS fans and a public announcement system. The aim is to reduce congestion on platforms, in circulating areas and at station approaches by providing designated spaces for waiting and ticketing.

. The government today launched the sixth edition of the National Startup Awards to recognise outstanding startups across the country. The awards recognise not just commercial success but also social impact, sustainability, and scalability. Launching the awards in New Delhi today, DPIIT Secretary Amardeep Singh said that startups can apply under 20 sectoral categories. He said that in addition, there are three special categories for women, students, and the North Eastern region. He added that the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade is at the forefront of driving reforms to promote startups. Mr Singh also emphasised the need for more private initiative to bring more startups in the country. He expressed hope that the awards would further boost the startup ecosystem in the country. The Secretary highlighted that the award covers a wide range of domains including agriculture, fintech, aerospace, health, education, and accessibility, among others. The applications for the award will remain open until 20 November this year.In line with the Government’s vision of Aatmanirbhar Bharat and the goal of a five-trillion-dollar economy, Startup India supports startups through initiatives such as startup recognition, tax exemptions, regulatory ease, funding access, and capacity building. Launched in 2016, Startup India has transformed India’s entrepreneurial landscape, fostering innovation and empowering youth, women, students, and first-time founders, particularly from Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. Over two lakh 25 thousand startups have been recognised by DPIIT so far.

. Union Minister Kiren Rijiju visited the historic Al Rahmah Mosque, popularly known as the Floating Mosque, in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. He described the mosque as a remarkable symbol of spiritual significance, architectural beauty and Saudi Arabia’s rich Islamic heritage.Minister Rijiju arrived in Jeddah yesterday to attend the 6th Haj Conference and Exhibition 2027 and participate in the signing of the bilateral Haj agreement with Saudi Arabia. He will also review preparations to ensure a safe, smooth and comfortable Haj journey for Indian pilgrims in 2027.Earlier, India’s Ambassador to Saudi Arabia, Vipul, met senior Saudi officials to review Haj preparations and strengthen coordination between the two countries. The Ambassador also inspected Jeddah’s Haj Terminal and Haramain High Speed Railway Station, which are key facilities for the movement of lakhs of Indian pilgrims travelling through the Haj Committee of India.

. India won a silver medal at the ongoing ISSF World Shooting Championships in Doha today. The Indian trio of Manu Bhaker, Suruchi Singh and Sainyam secured the silver medal in the women’s 10-metre air pistol team event. China won the gold medal in the event. With this silver medal, India’s overall medal tally has risen to four, comprising one gold and three silver medals.However, Manu and Suruchi endured a disappointing outing in the women’s 10 metre air pistol individual event at the Championships today, finishing outside the medal positions and missing out on the coveted quota places for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

. Benchmark domestic equity indices BSE and Nifty surged over 2% today, extending their stellar run for the 7th straight session. Defying weak global cues, the Sensex jumped 1,718 points to close at 81,028. The Nifty climbed 494 points to settle at 25,030. Conversely, the broader market on the National Stock Exchange underperformed the frontline indices. The Midcap 100 index ended almost flat with a negative bias, while the Smallcap 100 index dropped over 0.8%.

. Centre has directed all traders, wholesalers, Big Chain Retailers and processors across all States and Union Territories to declare their stock positions of rice and paddy. Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution Ministry said that all entities stocking rice and paddy are required to disclose their stock positions every Friday on the Food Stock Portal and ensure that the information furnished is accurate and regularly updated.The Ministry said that any entity found unregistered on the portal or violating the prescribed stock limits will be liable for appropriate punitive action under the Essential Commodities Act. It said, the government is closely monitoring food grain prices, particularly rice, and undertaking a series of policy interventions to ensure adequate domestic supplies, maintain price stability, prevent hoarding and safeguard consumer interests.With a view to ensuring the availability of rice to consumers at reasonable prices, particularly in the Southern States, Centre has conveyed its concurrence to the State Governments of Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Telangana to impose stock limits on paddy and rice. These stock limits shall remain in force up to 31st January next year. Central government has also doubled the target quantity of rice for sale through e-auction under the Open Market Sale Scheme for 2026-27. It has been increased from 25 lakh metric tonnes to 50 lakh metric tonnes.

. Minister of State for Commerce and Industry Jitin Prasada held a series of high-level meetings with Hungarian leaders, government representatives, industry stakeholders and academic institutions during his three-day visit to Hungary, which concluded today. The visit was aimed at strengthening bilateral cooperation in trade, investment, technology, innovation and industrial development.During the visit, Mr Prasada called on the Deputy Speaker of the Hungarian National Assembly. The interaction focused on strengthening bilateral relations and exploring opportunities for enhanced cooperation between India and Hungary, including in the broader context of India-European Union relations. He also met the Science and Technology Minister of Hungary. They discussed expanding bilateral cooperation in emerging technologies, research and innovation.The discussions also focused on exploring opportunities for greater collaboration between industries and research institutions of the two countries. Addressing the India-Hungary Business Seminar in Budapest, Mr Prasada called upon companies from both countries to strengthen partnerships and explore new investment opportunities. He highlighted potential cooperation in electronics, pharmaceuticals, agriculture and emerging technologies.

. US  technology stocks plunged after the US midterm elections raised concerns over a potential slowdown in artificial intelligence development and data centre expansion. The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite fell more than 5.5 percent yesterday, wiping out an estimated 2.5 trillion US dollars in market value. The S&P Global 500 dropped 4.4 per cent, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average declined more than 3.4 per cent.The market turmoil followed Democratic victories in the midterm elections, giving the party control of both chambers of Congress. Several Democrats campaigned on restricting data centre expansion and strengthening oversight of the AI industry.

. Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan has inaugurated the newly installed façade lighting system at Uprashtrapati Bhavan. The new lighting system is powered by grid-connected solar energy, reflecting the adoption of renewable energy in public infrastructure. The inauguration comes after the Vice-President highlighted India’s achievements in the renewable energy sector while addressing the valedictory session of the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Expo 2026 in New Delhi on Thursday.

. Major Asian stock markets ended on a mixed note today. South Korea’s Kospi plunged 5.3 per cent, Taiwan’s Taiex fell 3.2 per cent, and Japan’s Nikkei 225 dropped 1.8 per cent. In contrast, Hong Kong’s Hang Seng surged almost 3.7 per cent, Singapore’s Strait Times index added over half a per cent and China’s Shanghai Composite rose 0.1 per cent.In European markets, Germany’s DAX as well as London’s FTSE 100 rose 0.7 per cent, when reports last came in. Meanwhile, the Bank of England raised Bank Rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4 per cent.
. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold rose over 2.9 per cent to 1,41,622 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, silver was 5.5% up at 1,86, 133 rupees per kilogram.

. Minority Affairs Minister Kiren Rijiju today reached Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, to attend the 6th Haj Conference and Exhibition 2027. During his visit, the Minister will participate in the signing of the Bilateral Haj Agreement with Saudi Arabia and review preparations for Haj 2027. In a social media post, Mr Rijiju expressed hope that the engagements would be productive and focused on ensuring a smooth, safe and comfortable Haj journey for all Indian pilgrims.

. In the forex market today, the rupee appreciated by 18 paise to close at 94 rupees and 47 paise against the US dollar. The dollar index, which indicates US dollar’s strength against a basket of six other leading currencies, was trading at 101.56 in intra-day trade.

. Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football. In a social media post today, 41-year-old Ronaldo announced that he won’t play for Portugal anymore, ending a career that spanned six World Cups and included a European title and the men’s all-time international scoring record. The announcement marked the end of a lauded career that began more than two decades ago before Euro 2004 and finished with him walking out on the national team after falling out with coach Jorge Jesus. He said, the day has come for him to hand back the No. 7 shirt of Portuguese national team.Lionel Messi finished his career with Argentina after a much anticipated farewell match last month, Ronaldo’s final appearance with Portugal has ended up being on September 24 in a 1-nil win over Wales in the Nations League. The Portuguese soccer federation released a statement expressing deep gratitude and immense admiration for Ronaldo’s service to the country. Like Messi, Ronaldo will keep playing at club level, and is expected to finish his club career at the end of this season with Al-Nassr in Saudi Arabia. Ronaldo is in pursuit of his 1,000th career goal and sits on 985. Of those, a record 146 goals came in 234 appearances with Portugal.

. Indian Railways has announced 1,265 vacancies for Station Master posts across various Railway Recruitment Boards and zones, opening up new employment opportunities for graduate candidates. The Railways Ministry said that in an important recruitment-related decision, the Railway Board has prescribed that Station Master recruitment will be notified separately from 2026 onwards. The dedicated recruitment process provides candidates with a specific notification covering eligibility requirements, examination procedures and vacancy distribution for the post. The online application window will remain open till 25th of next month. Candidates are advised to review the detailed eligibility conditions, vacancy distribution and application instructions before submitting their forms. The recruitment reflects Indian Railways’ continued efforts to provide career opportunities to eligible candidates while strengthening its operational workforce.

. Electronics and Information Technology Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw has said that India remains focused on becoming the artificial intelligence (AI) “application capital” of the world. Speaking to the media in New Delhi yesterday, Mr Vaishnaw said the country is working towards expanding the use of Artificial Intelligence across key sectors, including agriculture, healthcare and education. He added that Indian industries are making significant progress in developing AI-based applications.Responding to questions on the recent global fall in technology stocks amid concerns over the future of AI investments, Mr Vaishnaw said the AI industry is undergoing a period of rapid change and uncertainty. He said India is focusing on expanding the use of AI across various sectors and developing applications that can bring about large-scale transformation.The Minister was speaking on the sidelines of the launch of the Semicon 2.0 Web Application Portal. He said the portal has been designed to accept only complete applications, ensuring participation by serious players in the semiconductor industry. Mr Vaishnaw also said that the roadmap for developing an indigenous Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) chip is being finalised. He added that the government will begin accepting applications under the second, third and fourth pillars of the semiconductor programme, giving further impetus to India’s semiconductor and electronics manufacturing ecosystem.

. Akashvani will broadcast the recording of the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, delivered by Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan, tonight at 9:30 PM. The recording will be broadcast across the entire Akashvani network on the occasion of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s birth anniversary.Delivering the 67th Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture, Mr Chouhan said that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s vision, determination and leadership laid the foundation for India’s national unity and territorial integrity. He said that Sardar Patel’s efforts to integrate 565 princely states remain a defining chapter in the country’s history. The Minister emphasised that Patel’s vision of a united India continues to inspire the nation through the spirit of ‘Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat’.Mr Chouhan also said that, inspired by Sardar Patel’s firm approach towards national security and his policy of zero tolerance towards terrorism, India has responded decisively to threats from across its borders, including through measures such as surgical strikes.As a tribute to Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who served as independent India’s first Deputy Prime Minister and Information and Broadcasting Minister, Akashvani has been organising the annual Sardar Patel Memorial Lecture since 1955. Over the years, the annual event has served as a rich repository of thoughts, ideas and perspectives on a wide range of subjects. It has also provided an opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of India’s diverse cultural heritage and the various dimensions of its developmental challenges.

. Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat today highlighted that India’s civilizational consciousness will offer valuable guidance in dealing with present day challenges in the country. The Minister stated this at the book launch of Timeless India: Protection and Revival of Indian Cultural Identity under the leadership of the Prime Minister in New Delhi. Mr Shekhawat said that this book offers a unique perspective on the initiatives undertaken by the government to safeguard and revive India’s rich cultural heritage. He emphasised that preserving and revitalising this legacy is essential not only for safeguarding the country’s historical identity but also for shaping its future.This book is written by Former Rajya Sabha Member Tarun Vijay and  published by Indira Gandhi National Centre of Arts and Surbhi publication.

. Paraguay’s Senate has voted to impeach and remove President Santiago Peña from office amid a political crisis linked to the collapse of a major financial institution and an ongoing criminal investigation. The Senate voted 44 to one in favour of removing Peña following a fast-tracked impeachment trial. Vice-President Pedro Alliana was subsequently sworn in as the country’s new President. Peña was placed under house arrest shortly after the vote.The political crisis followed the sudden closure of Ueno Bank, a financial institution with which Peña reportedly had business ties. The collapse left millions of depositors unable to access their savings and triggered a major investigation. Paraguay’s Attorney General has reportedly opened three separate criminal cases involving Peña and several former officials in connection with the financial crisis.Peña had announced his decision to resign in a video statement a day before the Senate vote. However, the Chamber of Deputies unanimously approved the initiation of impeachment proceedings, accusing him of serious and systematic dereliction of duty. The 44-year-old Peña assumed office in August 2023 for a five-year term. He represented the Colorado Party and was among the youngest presidents in Paraguay’s history.

. The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has issued guidelines to standardise the design and infrastructure of toll plazas on four-lane and wider National Highways.In a statement, the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways said the guidelines would ensure that upcoming and ongoing National Highway projects are equipped to support Multi-Lane Free Flow (MLFF)-based barrier-free toll collection, allowing vehicles to pass through toll plazas without stopping.The initiative aims to eliminate traffic congestion and waiting times at toll plazas, reduce fuel consumption and make journeys on National Highways safer and more seamless.The guidelines prescribe uniform standards for toll plaza layouts, lane configurations, road infrastructure, lighting, signage and other supporting facilities. They also provide an implementation framework to ensure that the required infrastructure is incorporated into both ongoing and upcoming National Highway projects.

. Coal and Mines Minister G. Kishan Reddy has said that India is targeting steel production of 300 million tonnes by 2030 and 500 million tonnes by 2047. He said the government is focusing on increasing iron ore production to meet growing demand and make steel more affordable.Addressing a press conference after the conclusion of the two-day Fourth Conference of Mining Ministers in Goa, Mr Reddy said the government is taking steps to strengthen the mining sector through expanded exploration, increased mineral production and greater transparency. He said India currently produces around 168 million tonnes of steel annually.The Minister emphasised that increasing the availability of steel and cement would also help make housing more affordable and fulfil the dream of homeownership for people across income groups. Mr Reddy stressed the need to make better use of existing mining dumps, pointing out that significant quantities of iron ore could still be recovered from previously extracted material.

. Indian pacer Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from Test cricket, bringing the curtain down on his 13-year career in the longest format of the game. However, he will continue to represent India in limited-overs cricket. Shami announced his decision in a social media post. He finished his Test career with 229 wickets from 64 matches at an average of 27.71, including six five-wicket hauls.The 36-year-old fast bowler ended his career as India’s sixth-highest wicket-taking fast bowler in Test cricket, behind Kapil Dev, Zaheer Khan, Ishant Sharma, Javagal Srinath and Jasprit Bumrah. With this announcement, Shami brings an end to a significant chapter in his international career while keeping his focus on the shorter formats of the game.

. The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the date sheet for the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations 2027. The examinations for both classes will begin on 16th February next year, with papers commencing at 10:30 AM. According to the official timetable, the Class 10 examinations will conclude on 9th March, while the Class 12 examinations will continue until 9th April. As per the notification, Class 10 students will appear for examinations in 83 subjects, while Class 12 students will take examinations in 121 subjects.The Board said the date sheet had been prepared after carefully considering more than 40,000 subject combinations to ensure that students do not face any clashes between examinations in the subjects they have opted for. Earlier, the Board had also announced the schedule for practical examinations and internal assessments for the 2026-27 academic session.For schools across India and abroad, practical examinations and internal assessments for Classes 10 and 12 will be conducted from 1st January to 13th February next year. However, for winter-bound schools, practical examinations will be held earlier, from 9th November to 19th December this year.More than 26.5 lakh students are expected to appear for the Class 10 board examinations, while over 19.8 lakh students will take the Class 12 examinations.Notably, the CBSE has released the date sheet 101 days ahead of the commencement of the board examinations. Students can access the detailed timetable on the Board’s official website, cbse.gov.in.

. UAE Minister of Economy and Tourism Abdulla bin Touq Al Marri led a 5 km community run organised by the Consulate General of India in Dubai, in collaboration with the Ministry of Economy and Tourism, as part of the Dubai 30×30 Fitness Challenge.The annual Dubai Fitness Challenge, launched in 2017, encourages residents and visitors to commit to 30 minutes of physical activity every day for 30 consecutive days. The month-long initiative brings together communities through a range of fitness activities and events across the city, promoting healthier and more active lifestyles.Consul General of India Dr E Vishnu Vardhan Reddy, along with more than 60 prominent Indian business leaders and entrepreneurs from the Indian Business and Professionals Council, UAE-India Business Council and Young Presidents’ Organization (YPO), with diverse backgrounds and ages, also participated in the run at Kite Beach, Jumeirah, on November 6.The Community Run reflects the spirit of inclusiveness of the Fitness Challenge and strong people-to-people India-UAE ties.

. In hockey, it was ‘Chak Dey’ moment for the defending champion India as the team lifted the trophy for the 6th time by defeating Japan 4-1 in the finals of 9th Hero Asian Hockey Championship at the Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali, last evening. Akashvani Correspondent reports that the jubilant crowd and the Nation celebrated the win as a Diwali gift by the hockey boys ahead of the festival.Although this was India’s third successive title, the winning team had to earn it against a strong defence by the rival team. An early lead by the Samurais kept the Indian Tigers on the toes till the end of the 3rd quarter, when they equalised the goal. The fourth and last quarter was dominated by India as the boys striked thrice to take an unassailable lead and won the Gold. India’s title-winning run was a perfect farewell to midfielder Nilakanta Sharma, who played his last international match in the national jersey. In another match for Bronze, Malaysia defeated South Korea by 5-2 .Celebrating India’s title win, Hockey India has announced a cash reward of Rs. 3 lakhs for each player and 1.5 lakhs for each member of the support staff.

. President Droupadi Murmu has extended her greetings on the completion of 151 years since the composition of the national song, Vande Mataram.In a social media post, President Murmu underscored that during the freedom movement, Vande Mataram served as a rallying cry of courage, unity and resolve for patriots. She emphasised that even today, Vande Mataram continues to symbolise national identity, self-respect and devotion to the motherland.The President also urged citizens to embrace the spirit of ‘Nation First’ reflected in Vande Mataram and channel its ideals towards strengthening the nation and contributing to its progress.

. In the Indian bullion market today, 24 carat gold rose 1.8 per cent to 1,44,129 rupees per 10 grams. Meanwhile, silver was 0.6 per cent up at 1,87,300 rupees per kilogram according to the closing rates of India Bullion and Jewellers Association.

. US President Donald Trump has named Stephen Miller, a key architect of his hardline immigration policies, as the new White House Chief of Staff. The appointment follows major losses for the Republican Party in the US midterm elections, which resulted in the party losing control of both chambers of Congress.Miller will replace Susie Wiles, who has stepped down from the position. President Trump praised her work, saying she had done a very good job, but added that changes were sometimes necessary.The 41-year-old Miller is one of President Trump’s closest aides and currently serves as Deputy Chief of Staff. He also held a senior advisory position during Trump’s first administration. He is scheduled to assume his new responsibilities on Monday.

. India’s 17-year-old tennis sensation Maaya Rajeshwaran Revathi has become the first Indian woman since Sania Mirza in 2012 to reach the quarter-finals of a WTA Tour-level singles event.Ranked 669th in the world, Maaya defeated Polish qualifier Weronika Falkowska, ranked 277th, 6-4, 6-3 in straight sets in the second round of the Chennai Open. No Indian player had progressed beyond the second round in the previous two editions of the tournament.Maaya’s breakthrough marks India’s return to the quarter-finals of a WTA Tour singles event after nearly 15 years. Sania Mirza last achieved the feat in February 2012, when she reached the quarter-finals of the Pattaya Open. Maaya continued her impressive rise this season by winning her maiden W35 singles title in Lagos, Portugal, in October as a qualifier without dropping a set. She also claimed the doubles title alongside Ukraine’s Yelyzaveta Kotliar.

. Defending champions India began their SAFF Championship title defence with a 3-2 victory over arch-rivals Pakistan in their opening Group B match at the National Stadium in Dhaka on Thursday.India dominated the first half, scoring three goals to establish a commanding lead. Suhail Ahmad Bhat opened the scoring in the 13th minute before doubling the advantage six minutes later with a fine finish. Manglenthang Kipgen added India’s third goal in the 32nd minute.Pakistan missed an opportunity to reduce the deficit when Shayak Dost failed to convert a penalty in the 34th minute.However, Pakistan staged a late fightback, scoring twice in stoppage time through Najeeb Ullah and Alamgir Ali Khan Ghazi in the 90+1st and 90+4th minutes.India held on to secure all three points and will next face the Maldives on November 11 in Dhaka.

Three major works of India’s literary and intellectual heritage including Kalhana’s Rajatarangini, the Mahabharata and Kautilya’s Arthashastra have been included in UNESCO’s Memory of the World Regional Register for Asia and the Pacific. The decision was taken at the 11th session of the register held in Jakarta, Indonesia. With this recognition, India’s total number of inscriptions in the regional register has risen to six. The three works represent different aspects of India’s knowledge traditions. Rajatarangini is a historical account of Kashmir, the Mahabharata explores Dharma, duty and human values, while Arthashastra deals with governance, diplomacy and statecraft. This recognition is a matter of pride for India’s civilisational continuity, its rich knowledge traditions and its contribution to the world. The development was announced by Member Secretary, Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA),  Dr. Sachchidanand Joshi which played an important role in preparing the nomination dossiers for all three works.

. The nationwide ‘Viksit Bharat Yuva Samvad: Know Your Vote’ campaign has concluded with 536 Yuva Samvads conducted across 31 States and Union Territories. The campaign organised by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports through Mera Yuva Bharat (MY Bharat) reached over one lakh young people and involved more than 5000 Youth Icons. The campaign brought discussions on electoral awareness to colleges and educational institutions across the country. It encouraged young people, particularly first-time voters, to understand their voting rights and electoral procedures and participate responsibly in democracy.The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports said that the campaign witnessed participation by Governors, Union Ministers, State Ministers, Members of Parliament and other public representatives. It added that sports personalities and youth icons from the sporting community also participated in programmes, sharing their experiences and encouraging youth participation in sports.The Yuva Samvads provided young participants with opportunities to seek clarity on electoral procedures, discuss voting rights and civic responsibilities, and interact directly with public representatives and Youth Icons.

. In Men’s Cricket, the second ODI of the five-match series between India and New Zealand will be played in Wellington tomorrow morning. The match will begin at 7:30 AM Indian Standard Time. The visitors will look to extend their lead to 2-0 after registering a five-wicket victory in the rain-affected opening match in Auckland. New Zealand, on the other hand, will aim to bounce back and level the series. New Zealand have suffered a setback as their lead batter Devon Conway ruled out the remaining four matches of the series. Left-handed batter Nick Kelly replaces Conway.

The three public sector Oil Marketing Companies – Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited – have clarified that the E20 petrol supplied by them across the country complies with the Bureau of Indian Standards specifications for ethanol-blended motor gasoline.The clarification follows a press release issued by the Karnataka Government’s Department of Food, Civil Supplies, Consumer Affairs and Legal Metrology, which claimed that petrol sold at certain retail outlets in the state contained between 26 and 31 per cent ethanol.The Oil Marketing Companies said that tests conducted on 893 samples collected from 27 States and Union Territories, including 56 samples from Karnataka, found that all the samples met the prescribed specifications.

Young badminton player Tanvi Patri has created history by becoming the first Indian to reach the women’s badminton final at the Youth Olympic Games in Dakar.Tanvi defeated Japan’s Yuzuno Watanabe 21-14, 11-21, 21-19 in a hard-fought 54-minute semifinal to book her place in the title clash. She had earlier scripted history by becoming the first Indian woman to reach the semifinals, defeating Thailand’s Kungkaew Kakanik.Tanvi is the fourth Indian shuttler to reach the badminton semifinals at the Youth Olympic Games, joining an elite list that includes H. S. Prannoy, Lakshya Sen and Aditya Joshi. Tanvi will now face China’s Yi Xin Zhang in the final today.

. The depression, a remnant of Cyclone Arnab, over south Chhattisgarh and adjoining south Odisha has moved northwards.It is now centred over central Chhattisgarh and adjoining Odisha. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) said it is likely to move further north and weaken into a well-marked low-pressure area over north Chhattisgarh tonight.Meanwhile, IMD has issued a red alert for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall in Bihar tomorrow.An orange alert has been issued for very heavy rainfall in East Uttar Pradesh, Sub-Himalayan West Bengal, Sikkim and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands tomorrow. Heavy rainfall is also expected in Jharkhand and Uttarakhand.Thunderstorms accompanied by hail are likely over East Rajasthan, Haryana, Chandigarh, Uttarakhand and West Uttar Pradesh.Thunderstorms and gusty winds are also forecast in several other states, including Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Assam and Meghalaya.Meanwhile Delhi witnessed light to moderate rainfall this evening. The IMD has forecast very light rain accompanied by thunderstorms and lightning tomorrow morning.The maximum temperature is expected to remain between 26 and 28 degrees Celsius, while the minimum temperature is likely to range from 16 to 18 degrees Celsius.

. In men’s cricket, India bowled out New Zealand for just 134 runs in 41 overs in the first innings of the second ODI in Wellington. Gurnoor Brar led the bowling attack with an impressive four-wicket haul, while Auqib Nabi and Axar Patel claimed two wickets each.Earlier, Indian skipper Shubman Gill won the toss and elected to bowl, making the most of the overcast conditions. New Zealand struggled to build partnerships, although Daryl Mitchell’s half-century and Mitchell Santner’s 31 runs provided some resistance in the middle order.The match was reduced to 47 overs per side due to rain, with India needing 135 runs for victory. India entered the contest with a 1-0 lead after winning the rain-affected first ODI by five wickets, with Virat Kohli starring with a knock of 74.

The National Health Authority, under the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, reviewed the progress of two flagship healthcare initiatives – Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) and the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM). The review focused on expanding beneficiary coverage, improving healthcare delivery, strengthening financial protection and accelerating the adoption of digital health services.The two-day National Review Meeting, which concluded in Kolkata yesterday, brought together senior officials from States and Union Territories to assess the progress of both schemes and discuss priorities for their next phase of implementation. The discussions also highlighted the role of technology, data analytics, automation and Artificial Intelligence in improving operational efficiency, transparency, accountability and healthcare outcomes.Addressing the meeting, National Health Authority Chief Executive Officer Dr Sunil Kumar Barnwal said the next phase of implementation must go beyond expanding coverage and focus on ensuring better-quality healthcare for beneficiaries. He stressed that every rupee spent on healthcare must translate into better care for the people.

. The Department of Pension and Pensioners’ Welfare will conduct the month-long fifth nation-wide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) campaign across the country from the 1st of next month. Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions Ministry said that this is the biggest-ever DLC Campaign undertaken by the Ministry. Electronics and Information Technology Ministry and UIDAI will provide technical support during this campaign. The Ministry said that the initiative will be adopted with a Whole of Government approach with the objective of reaching pensioners in the remotest corners of the country with focus on Face Authentication Technology. The Ministry said that face Authentication for Digital Life Certificate is a seamless and fast mode for DLC generation which can be used both on Android and Apple devices, making it easy and convenient for elderly Pensioners.The Campaign will be conducted in an Utsav mode by offering a bouquet of services such as Health Check-ups and Aadhaar updation for pensioners. Doorstep services to be provided to pensioners based on their requirement.

. US President Donald Trump participated in a ceremonial diya-lighting ceremony at the White House to mark Diwali. The gathering brought together prominent members of the Indian-American community to celebrate the festival of lights.India’s Ambassador to the United States, Vinay Kwatra, was among those present in the Oval Office during the celebrations. On the occasion, Indian technology entrepreneur Vishal Gondal gifted President Trump a copy of the Hanuman Chalisa.The tradition of celebrating Diwali at the White House was started by former President George W. Bush in 2003. Initially, the celebrations were largely held at the Eisenhower Executive Office Building in the presence of members of the Indian-American community and Indian diplomats.In 2009, former President Barack Obama became the first US President to light a ceremonial lamp at the White House during a Diwali celebration in the East Room. Since then, Diwali lamp-lighting ceremonies have been held at various locations within the White House, including the Oval Office and the Roosevelt Room.

. Iran has sent the United States a nuclear proposal through Qatar, but discussions will begin only after Washington meets Tehran’s seven demands. Iranian officials have demanded the lifting of US sanctions, the release of frozen Iranian assets and war reparations, among other conditions. Tehran has also warned it will not reopen the Strait of Hormuz or negotiate until its demands are met. Iran’s top security official Mohsen Rezaei reiterated the conditions during a visit to Russia yesterday. Washington, meanwhile, has insisted that nuclear issues must be included in any initial negotiations. Mediators have stepped up efforts to end the conflict amid fears of renewed fighting. US President Donald Trump has not ruled out resuming military operations after the US midterm elections.
